title: Capability Manifest Entry
description: One agent-callable action. This is the ONLY discovery surface an agent sees for this action — do not maintain a separate, shorter description anywhere else in the stack.

name.description: Stable, unique action identifier. Verb-first (e.g. 'issue_refund', not 'refund' or 'refunds_create').

intent.description: Written for an agent deciding whether to call this action right now. State what it does and when to use it. This is prose for a model, not for a human skimming API docs — be concrete about triggering situations, not just mechanically restating the endpoint name.

whenNotToUse.description: Explicitly rule out adjacent/confusable actions. Required, not optional — most agent misuse is picking the almost-right tool, and this field is what prevents it.

sideEffects.description: none = read-only. idempotent = mutating but safe to retry and low-stakes. consequential = costs money, is irreversible, affects a third party, or changes a security/access boundary. Drives which other contracts (idempotency, async, guardrail) apply — see constitution.md.

costTier.description: Rough operational or financial cost of one call, for an agent or its budget-aware orchestrator to weigh before calling. Required when sideEffects is 'consequential'.

latencyBudgetMs.description: Maximum acceptable synchronous latency before this action MUST instead be exposed via the async job contract. Default 2000 if unspecified.

requiresDryRun.description: MUST be true when sideEffects is 'consequential' (constitution.md, Article 5).

idempotent.description: MUST be true (with an idempotency key required in inputSchema) whenever sideEffects is not 'none' (constitution.md, Article 3).

inputSchema.description: A full JSON Schema for this action's parameters. Every required field must actually be required here — no undocumented required fields discovered only via a runtime error.

outputSchema.description: A full JSON Schema for this action's successful result shape.

errors.description: Failure modes this action can produce, each corresponding to an entry in this action's error mapping table (error-envelope.schema.json).

specRef.description: Path to the action-spec.md this manifest entry was generated from. Required so the manifest is traceable back to a source of truth (constitution.md, Article 0) — never generated ad hoc.
